$comment: DoorTypes.json — THE DOOR CATALOGUE. Sits beside RoomShapes.json because a door is a
SUBFEATURE OF THE ROOM SYSTEM, not a thing of its own: room.html places doorways on a room's
walls, doors.html designs what fills them, and both read THIS file. One catalogue, one truth.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL (Mark, 2026-08-26):
'we had various naming that made it impossible to get right.'
He is right, and here is the exact failure. The word DOOR was used for THREE different
things at once, across ~20 identifiers — _cabDoors, _cabDoorLeaves, _cabDoorTiles,
_woodDoubleDoors, shojiDoorPanels, _pendingExtraDoors, _sectionDoorsOpenNow, _doorTiles,
_doorSet, _doorCarve, _doorJambs, shoji_door, _mt.door, _mkDoor, _mkCabDoor._mkLeaf,
_mkDoubleDoorUnit. Nobody could tell from a name whether it meant a HOLE, a MESH, or a
TILE TYPE, so every fix landed on the wrong object and the next seat re-broke it.
THE VOCABULARY. FOUR WORDS. EACH MEANS EXACTLY ONE THING. NOTHING ELSE IS CALLED A DOOR:
DOORWAY  the OPENING. A property of the MAP — a tile type. It is an ABSENCE. It has no mesh,
no material and no theme. Delete a doorway and the dungeon SEALS. Generators own it.
LEAF     the single PANE that fills a doorway. A MESH, one box, in the wall line, wearing the
art. It is never a tile. Render owns it. If it is not a mesh, it is not a leaf.
SPAN     how many TILES wide the doorway is. 1 or 2. Never metres — metres are span x grid.
THEME    which ART a leaf wears. Mirrors the room's WALL_STYLE so a room and its doors match.
THE ONE GEOMETRY RULE, and it is arithmetic, not architecture:
CONTAIN-FIT the art inside its (span*grid x wallHeight) box:  k = min(w/artW, h/artH).
Letterbox. NEVER stretch. Whatever the leaf does not fill, WALL fills — at the sides, or as
a header band above (a real door is SHORTER than the wall it sits in).

spans.note: the default. One tile of wall becomes doorway.

spans.role: hall, cabaret, temple gate, stair head
spans.note: needs a 2-tile wall run; room.html REFUSES it on a 1-tile side rather than sliding it.

themes.name: 障子
themes.note: paper and lattice; the lightest leaf.

themes.name: キャバレー
themes.note: lacquer red and brass; Mark's treasured room, so its door is the loudest.

themes.name: 番所
themes.note: banded timber and iron; the heaviest leaf.

themes.name: コンビニ
themes.note: glass and alloy; the only modern leaf. Dedication room — keep it warm, never clinical.

$art: EVERY `art` PATH ABOVE MAY BE MISSING, AND THAT IS FINE ON PURPOSE. Mark 2026-08-26: 'dont
worry about textures we will have various ones to go through.' A leaf whose PNG does not load
falls back to a PROCEDURAL leaf drawn from `palette`, so a theme is usable the moment it is
named here and swapping in real art later is a one-line path change with no code edit.
The old art was deleted on 2026-08-26 and is recoverable from git at b77b00c0 if wanted.
